about: One list per consumer of headless-chromium whose words its source must not hold: draw's, as the four shared parts' vocabulary checks refuse it on behalf of their first consumer, and input-tester's, the parts' second. Test data: never in src/, never in a release. A word headless-chromium genuinely needs is allowed by its exact text, in the one file named, here and in docs/DECISIONS.md, never by loosening the match.
